program.name: Yoga Strength
program.subject: Yoga
program.blurb: Yoga for strength: chaturangas, crow and boat for the upper body, chair and warriors for the legs.
program.about: Yoga for strength rather than stretch. One day works arms and core with plank, dolphin, crow and boat held on the clock; the other works legs and balance with chair, warriors and one-leg poses. Each starts with salutations and ends with rest. Level II brings harder poses first and Level III holds them longer.
